description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the behavior of 'git log' with various pathspecs and options within a Git repository. It includes setup, test cases, and expectations for handling ambiguous paths, detached HEAD states, submodules, and pathspec magic patterns.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a shell code block.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test finishes, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expected to fail, verifying its failure.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern appears in the command's error output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output for differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of testing sequence.
